TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is a Pakistan-incorporated IT and infrastructure delivery firm established in 2012, with offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore and Karachi and a 250-person team including PMP-certified project managers and PE-registered engineers. [CO-PROFILE] We are ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified and also hold CMMI Level 3, aligning to PITB’s mandatory quality and information security requirements for an enterprise network and data-centre rollout. [CO-PROFILE]

For PITB’s “Supply, Installation and Configuration of Enterprise Network and Data-Centre Infrastructure across Six Regional Offices,” we bring recent, high-value network delivery proof points exceeding the PKR 30M threshold, including network design deployments valued at PKR 44M (completed 2025), PKR 182M (completed 2022) and PKR 133M (completed 2020). [CAP-021][CAP-009][CAP-033] These engagements evidence our capability to plan, implement and commission enterprise network architectures at scale, supported by disciplined delivery controls aligned to our certified management systems. [CO-PROFILE]

We will submit a PITB-compliant commercial response, including 90-day quotation validity and bid security at 2% via CDR/bank guarantee from a scheduled bank within our existing bank guarantee facility. [CO-PROFILE] We are also FBR-registered with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, as required. [CO-PROFILE]

Noted compliance focus items:
- Single-OEM active equipment and partner/reseller authorisation: our library does not yet evidence this; we will address it by securing OEM authorisation for the proposed brand prior to award. 
- 24x7 helpdesk with 4-hour on-site response: our evidenced model is 24–48h SLAs; we will meet PITB’s critical-response requirement by staffing an on-call roster and positioning spares/engineers regionally for the warranty period. [CO-PROFILE]

Our commitment is to deliver a resilient, well-documented rollout with structured knowledge transfer to PITB’s operations team and dependable warranty support throughout the first year. [CO-PROFILE]
